high_level_description: The image shows a person standing outdoors in front of a large, elegant building with a modern architectural style. The building features white walls, arched windows, and a dark roof with a chimney. There is a well-maintained lawn with green grass and several trees, including a large evergreen tree to the left and smaller shrubs around the area. The person is wearing a stylish outfit consisting of a black sleeveless top paired with a black pleated mini skirt. Over the top, they have a black and white patterned jacket draped over their shoulders.
